Good to know

Frequently asked questions

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. Tell us about the job and we'll give you a clear, written, no-obligation quote — no pressure to book.

What areas do you serve?

We serve Denver and the greater Denver metro, plus surrounding Colorado communities. Not sure if you're in our area? Just ask.

Are you insured?

Yes, Brilliant Landscaping LLC is fully insured, so your property is covered and you can relax while we work.

How soon can you come out?

Often within a few days, depending on the season and scope. Send us a message and we'll find you the soonest available slot.

Do you handle both one-time projects and regular maintenance?

Both. We take on full landscape installs and design projects as well as recurring lawn care and seasonal maintenance — whatever keeps your yard looking its best.
